_about: Everything a player can carry in their Pack (scripts/camp/camp_pack.gd), the Pack itself and dropped bundles. Each player has pack_slots slots; a slot holds a stack of one item, up to stack_max. Nothing is ever lost: a full Pack just can't take more, and what can't fit stays where it is. items: each item's kind (fish, meal, fruit, plant or material), which requests ask for (data/guests.json); box: true when the camp box takes it (materials). fuel lists the items the fire burns to grill, one per meal, from the Pack first and then the camp box. A dropped stack lies as a bundle (model) at the dropper's feet and never goes away; a stack dropped within merge_m of a bundle of the same item joins it. reach_m is how near a player picks a bundle up or reaches the camp box (box_model in data/clearing.json). tools: the tools each player cycles through like Animal Crossing's, in order (every player has all of them; names: data/text.json tool.<id>); needs says which tool a step needs in hand (chopping the axe, fishing the rod, a photo of an animal the camera); everything else works with any tool. held is the model shown in the mitten for each tool (none for hands) and its turn in degrees; both PCs see it. Names: data/text.json items.<item>.
